seo.title: Snibe and Bio-Rad Services and Maintenance | LabWell
seo.description: LabWell supplies Snibe and Bio-Rad instruments, reagents and controls, with solution selection, installation, training, maintenance and application support.

lead: LabWell is an official distributor of Snibe and Bio-Rad in Ukraine. We help you choose a solution, supply instruments, reagents and controls, and provide services for all instruments from both brands.

services.title: Solution selection
services.text: We help you select the most effective solution for your needs. Contact LabWell to discuss your laboratory’s requirements.

services.title: Supply
services.text: We supply Snibe and Bio-Rad instruments, reagents and controls. Contact LabWell about the instruments and materials your laboratory needs.

services.title: Installation and training
services.text: We install Snibe and Bio-Rad instruments. We train your laboratory staff to operate them.

services.title: Maintenance
services.text: We provide warranty and post-warranty maintenance. This service covers all Snibe and Bio-Rad instruments.

services.title: Application support
services.text: A specialist advises on reagent performance and helps you interpret results. If a result is erroneous, they help you investigate possible causes.

items.question: Which instruments do LabWell’s services cover?
items.answer: All LabWell services are available for all Snibe and Bio-Rad instruments, from solution selection to maintenance and application support.

items.question: Does LabWell train staff to use the instrument?
items.answer: Yes, LabWell installs the instrument and trains your staff to operate it. Installation and training are available for all Snibe and Bio-Rad instruments.

items.question: Is maintenance available after the warranty ends?
items.answer: Yes, LabWell provides both warranty and post-warranty maintenance for all Snibe and Bio-Rad instruments.

items.question: What can I ask an application support specialist?
items.answer: You can ask about reagent performance, result interpretation and possible causes of erroneous results. A LabWell specialist helps you work through these questions.

contact.title: Discuss your needs with a specialist
contact.text: Tell us which tests your laboratory performs or what you need help with. We will help you select a solution and answer your questions.
